Netmeds is a real, legitimate online pharmacy company owned by Reliance Retail in India. It is not a fake website, but customers often complain about slow deliveries, poor customer service, and occasional issues with order cancellations. [](https://www.reddit.com/r/mumbai/comments/zqhgrl/how_trustworthyreliable_is_netmeds_or_pharmeasy_is/)

- **Legitimate Business:** Operated and owned by a major corporate group (Reliance).

- **Services:** Offers prescription delivery, over-the-counter drugs, and diagnostic lab tests.

- **Scam Warning:** Scammers sometimes make fake phone calls pretending to be Netmeds support to steal money or UPI pins. [](https://www.netmeds.com/page/scam-alert)

### Common User Complaints

- **Late Deliveries:**

Orders can take much longer to arrive than the app estimates.

- **Customer Support:** Getting refunds or help for delayed orders is often difficult.

- **Impostor Scams:** Fraudsters use the brand name to run separate phishing or payment scams. [](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/m.netmeds.com?page=3)
